text: Four questions on the Second Punic War, relations first. Use See in lesson after each answer if you want to check the source.

items.stem: What does the graph mark as the immediate trigger of the war?
items.why: Rome treated Hannibal's siege of Saguntum (219 BCE) as grounds for war; the Sardinia grievance is a contested background cause.

items.stem: Why could Rome keep fighting after Cannae?

options.text: Most of its Italian allies stayed loyal

items.why: Loyal allies meant Rome could keep replacing its losses, which Carthage could not match.

items.stem: Match each person to what they did.
items.explain: Fabius's delay bought time; Scipio's invasion of Africa forced Hannibal home.
